generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), family 260 Aristolochiaceae: leaves simple, mostly entire, without stipules; flowers with an often enlarged, petal-like calyx, its limb 3-lobed or one-sided, and no petals; ovary inferior or rarely half inferior; fruit a capsule, rarely not opening. APG's family holds Asarum too, whose calyx is three-lobed in the same way. Hutchinson calls the leaves alternate; Asarum's crowd near the rhizome's tip, often seeming paired, so the arrangement is left to the genera.
